ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the “Diagram of the Relationship Between Chinese Policy and Cotton Production”. <image1> What was the main factor affecting the change in China's cotton sown area from 1998 to 2000?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure displays side by side the changes in three indicators of China's cotton purchase guidance price, sown area, and yield per unit area in 1998 and 2000. The cotton purchase guidance price fell from 617.5 yuan/dan to 390.0 yuan/dan, marked as a decrease of 37%; the sown area fell from 4.459 million hectares to 4.041 million hectares, marked as a decrease of 9%; the yield per unit area rose from 1009 kg/hectare to 1093 kg/hectare, marked as an increase of 8%. Then reason: the question asks about the main factor affecting the change in cotton sown area from 1998 to 2000. The decrease in sown area is consistent in direction with the large decrease in the cotton purchase guidance price, while the yield per unit area instead rose and cannot explain the reduction in sown area. The cotton purchase guidance price belongs to a policy factor, so the main factor is policy.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the “Diagram of the Relationship Between Chinese Policy and Cotton Production”.

<image1>

What was the main factor affecting the change in China's cotton sown area from 1998 to 2000?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中并列显示棉花收购指导价、播种面积、单位面积产量在1998年与2000年的变化。再推理：题目问播种面积变化的主要因素，比较可见播种面积下降与收购指导价大幅下降方向一致，而单位面积产量反而上升，不能作为面积减少的主因。收购指导价是政策性因素，所以答案判为“政策”。
